earnings.title: October 20, 2026
highlights: On a year-to-date basis , net sales rose 38.6% versus the print in 2025, reflecting better prices for all our products and an increase in the sales volume for zinc (+2.0%).
3Q26 net income hit a record high of $1,801.8 million, up 62.7% versus the $1,107.6 million registered in 3Q25 due to higher net sales.
The net income margin in 3Q26 stood at 38.4%, versus 32.8% in 3Q25.
On a YTD basis, net income was 66.8% higher than in 2025 due to growth in net sales.
outlook: The estimated capital investment is $2.6 billion, and operations are expected to begin in 2031.
We estimate an investment of approximately $2.5 billion will be required and expect production start-up by 2032.

items.heading: Our financial performance is highly dependent on the price of copper and the other metals we produce.
Volatility in metals prices may also impact the price of our outstanding securities.
Our business requires levels of capital investments that we may not be able to maintain.
Restrictive covenants in the agreements governing our indebtedness and the indebtedness of our Minera Mexico subsidiary may restrict our ability to pursue our business strategies.
We may not pay a significant amount of our net income as cash dividends on our common stock in the future.
Our ability to recognize the benefits of deferred tax assets is dependent on future cash flows and taxable income.
